# Best MagSafe car mounts (Qi2)

**Best for most iPhone drivers: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W vent mount, about $47.99**
- It includes a 27W car adapter and a USB-C cable, and rotates between portrait and landscape.
- Check your vents first. Belkin's specs call for slats up to 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep, and straight horizontal slats work best. Vertical or shallow vents can droop.
- It handles cases up to 3 mm thick.
- Sources: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

**Best for fast charging and heat: Anker Prime MagGo AirCool (A2933), $89.99**
- It charges at Qi2 25W and has thermoelectric cooling plus a fan. [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/) uses it as their daily driver and rates it best overall.
- Only some phones get the full 25W: iPhone 17, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. The iPhone 16 and 16 Pro top out at 22W, and iPhone 15 and earlier at about 15W.
- It doesn't fit Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vehicles or cars without vent blades. It isn't compatible with the iPhone 16e.
- The sources disagree on the adapter. MountGuys and The Gadgeteer say a 60W adapter comes in the box, while the other reviews say you need a 45W+ car adapter. Confirm what's included on the listing before buying.
- Sources: [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/), [CloudsPress](https://www.cloudspress.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

**Best value with a fan: ESR HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost**
- It's a Qi2-certified 15W mount with a built-in fan, and it attaches to a vent or the dashboard.
- A car adapter doesn't appear to be included, so budget $10 to $15 more.
- Prices vary by source. ESR's store lists it at $39.99, or $32.80 with code PARTNER18 (18% off, which the deal site says it tested on 2026-10-22). The Gadgeteer lists it at $18.99. Check the current price at checkout.
- [Buy at ESR's US store](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost) (affiliate link, no extra cost to you)

**Other options from the reviews**
- **LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan, from $39.95:** The Gadgeteer's top pick, with a 95W adapter included. Its fan-off mode caps charging at 15W. See the [review](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/).
- **PITAKA MagEZ Car Mount Pro 2, $59.99:** It has a good design and an NFC Shortcuts trigger, but no fan, so it may throttle on hot dashboards. See the [review](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/).
- **Non-charging backup:** The VICSEED steel-core vent mount is MountGuys' pick if you don't want a cable. See [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/).

**Tips**
- A Qi2 badge matters. "MagSafe-compatible" without Qi2 may mean only 7.5W charging.
- Ignore the "80 lb suction" claims on cheap listings. Those describe the suction cup, not the magnet grip.
- If your vents are poor, pick a dash-capable version such as Belkin's vent/dash model or a suction mount.

I couldn't open the retailer pages, so apart from the ESR link above, the links go to the reviews rather than direct purchase pages. Each review has Amazon buy buttons. Tell me your phone model and whether you'd rather mount on a vent or the dash, and I can narrow it to one pick.
